attention_tiers.label: Watch closely
attention_tiers.rule: ≥6/8 flags and a named pattern (breakout / near buy zone / silent accumulation)

attention_tiers.label: Potential setup
attention_tiers.rule: ≥5/8 flags, or ≥4/8 flags with a named pattern

risk_conditions.label: ATR ≥2.5% of price — large typical daily swings
RSI(14) ≥75 or ≤25 — momentum at an extreme
Price below EMA200 — long-term trend is down

risk_levels: count of conditions: 0–1 low · 2–3 elevated · ≥4 high

trend_rules.daily: bullish: close > EMA50 > EMA200 · bearish: close < EMA50 < EMA200 · else neutral
trend_rules.weekly: bullish: weekly close above a rising 10-week EMA · bearish: below a falling one · else neutral · null under 15 weeks of history
trend_rules.intraday: not collected — the pipeline fetches daily candles only

note: All labels are counts/thresholds of named conditions — never a weighted score.
